notices.title: New EP 'These Days' — Church Lench Singer-Songwriter
notices.body:
Church Lench singer-songwriter George Webb has released a new four-track EP called THESE DAYS.

George grew up in Church Lench and now regularly performs live across Worcestershire and the surrounding area, playing a mixture of his own music and covers.
THESE DAYS features four original songs: WEBB FEST, THESE DAYS, FIND ME and MANTRA. The songs were written over a number of years and are inspired by family, friends, trips away and everyday life.

George wrote, recorded and mixed the entire EP himself in Church Lench.
To celebrate the release, George held a launch night at The Wayside, which brought together friends, family and plenty of familiar faces.

George said:
“Family, friends and trips away. That pretty much sums up my music. These are songs I wrote a while ago, so it’s been great to finally bring them together and release them as an EP. Having so many friends and familiar faces there for the launch made it even better.”

THESE DAYS is available now on Spotify, Apple Music and other major streaming platforms.

Track listing:

WEBB FEST
THESE DAYS
FIND ME
MANTRA

More information and music can be found on George’s social channels. Search @georgewebb_music, give George a follow and look out for more releases throughout 2027.
